description: This file defines classes related to kernel port representations in a hardware-accelerated application builder. It includes classes for general ports, runtime parameter ports (RTPPort), and buffer ports (BufferPort), encapsulating attributes such as port metadata, array buffers, and slicing behavior.

classes.name: Port
classes.description: Represents a generic port with attributes such as name, datatype, direction, connection type, and parent Kernel.

classes.name: RTPPort
classes.description: Specialized port representing a Runtime Parameter (RTP) with a value attribute.

classes.name: BufferPort
classes.description: Port holding a NumPy buffer array with slicing capabilities, representing kernel buffer ports.

methods.name: Port.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a Port instance with specified attributes.

methods.name: Port._to_pbase_metadata
methods.description: Creates a dictionary with base metadata for the port.

methods.name: Port.to_metadata
methods.description: Returns metadata dictionary for the port.

methods.name: Port.metadata
methods.description: Property that returns a ReprDict object encapsulating the port's metadata.

methods.name: RTPPort.__init__
methods.description: Initializes an RTPPort with a value, inheriting from Port.

methods.name: RTPPort.copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the RTPPort, optionally with a new parent.

methods.name: RTPPort.to_metadata
methods.description: Returns metadata for the RTPPort, including its value.

methods.name: BufferPort.__init__
methods.description: Initializes a BufferPort with a NumPy array, slices, and other attributes.

methods.name: BufferPort._validate_array
methods.description: Validates that the underlying array is a NumPy ndarray.

methods.name: BufferPort.copy
methods.description: Creates a copy of the BufferPort with optional new parent and slices.

methods.name: BufferPort.__getitem__
methods.description: Allows slicing of the buffer port, adding slices.

methods.name: BufferPort.__setitem__
methods.description: Sets a value in the parent using the buffer port index.

methods.name: BufferPort.array
methods.description: Getter that returns the array after applied slices.

methods.name: BufferPort.array (setter)
methods.description: Sets the array contents depending on the parent ttype.

methods.name: BufferPort.offset
methods.description: Returns the byte offset into the original array based on slices.

methods.name: BufferPort.nbytes
methods.description: Returns the total byte size of the current array.

methods.name: BufferPort.shape
methods.description: Returns the shape of the current array.

methods.name: BufferPort.to_metadata
methods.description: Returns metadata including shape and dtype of the array.
